My friend Lydia has a son, Leo—he's 7—and he would throw his pencil every time a math worksheet appeared. So when I handed her this little logic grid puzzle…she walked away expecting the worst. If you've been looking into skyscraper for kids, you're in the right place.

Boring is the enemy. These variations will save your sanity. I swear. Here's the fun part — because kids discover patterns differently, all you need is one template and a new set of "occupants."
